confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city context only. No menus, listings, booking pages, or current CLP rates were checked, and price levels are extrapolated to the July 2026 window. Restaurant and café anchors are the most reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors vary by neighborhood and season, and July is winter, generally a softer tourist period than summer. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor, so they are less certain. USD values assume roughly 950 CLP per USD. The FX observation came from web-search snippets of RBA data, not from a page opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Latin American capitals in the upper-middle price band. Santiago is treated as one of the pricier South American capitals, so anchors sit above cheaper capitals such as Lima and Bogotá and broadly in the range of other upper-middle-cost regional capitals such as Mexico City and Montevideo.
